limitations: Not a .pb-parametric project and cannot reconstruct all dependencies or placement rules.
Five C-coordinate labels on page11 are visibly truncated in the original rendered PDF; they are not guessed.
Signed negative coordinates and face1/face2 require the original datum/orientation contract before machining.
Through(0.0) is a through-hole designation, not a zero-depth blind hole.
Page20 contains two identical printed zero-length groove rows; preserved as source data requiring review.
No validated postprocessor, tools, feeds, machine controller, hold-down or physical acceptance data supplied.
Furniture/hardware identifiers are references in one project, not supplier-certified catalogs.
Current RokaDex prototype cannot claim exact production equivalence to this report.
